description: Fires an entity event on the shooter, the projectile, the entity hit, and/or all entities in a splash radius.

affect_projectile.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the projectile entity itself.

affect_shooter.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the projectile's shooter.

affect_splash_area.description: If `true`, the event is fired on every entity within `splash_area` blocks of the impact.

affect_target.description: If `true`, the event is fired on the entity hit by the projectile.

event_trigger.description: Event trigger (with optional filters) to fire on the selected target(s).
